svg.title: At least and more than use different continuous boundaries
svg.desc: For X binomial with forty trials and probability one half, both expected successes and failures equal twenty, exceeding five. The matching normal Y has mean twenty and variance ten. The upper panel highlights the bars twenty and above and uses continuous boundary nineteen point five. Its normal tail is approximately 0.5628. The lower panel highlights twenty-one and above and uses boundary twenty point five. Its normal tail is approximately 0.4372. Bars show probability mass and the orange curve shows density on the same count scale. The plot displays the central count range from ten to thirty; calculated normal tails are unbounded. The approximations differ because the discrete event changes, not because an isolated continuous boundary point has positive probability.
